questions.question: Four numbers have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.questionHtml: Four numbers have been given, out of  which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

1st Number × 3rd Number = 2nd Number

1) 600 → 6 × 0 = 0

2) 441 → 4 × 1 = 4

3) 324 → 3 × 4 = 12 ≠ 2

4) 393 → 3 × 3 = 9

Hence, ‘324’ is the odd one out.

Confusion Points

  • All numbers are divisible by 3, so divisibility rule does not follow.
  • 441 and 324 both are perfect square of 21 and 18, so logic of a perfect square does not follow.
